title: The Spotlight editor's preview shows the real page, in its own theme, after every edit

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-19 (project thread: Redesign the Spotlight editor): 'the display is way off. Color / transparency on the boxes are way off.' Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/WX5fSWaGKNuKhe8iXbPSYf, phase 1.

detail: The preview was drawn inside the member console, so the member kit's glass card rule (members-ui.css, .fqm-center .rounded-card.border.bg-surface) and kit type painted over the Space's theme: grey see-through boxes on a dark page. A themed Spotlight also drew only its last saved copy, so edits never showed. The preview is now the real Spotlight page (app/spaces/[slug]/spotlight/preview, managers only, never indexed) in a phone-width iframe that stays in view, reloads after each save or theme change and keeps its scroll place. Link presses inside it do nothing and are never counted.

verify.note: Fails while the editor draws the Spotlight inside the console instead of framing the real page.
